note: Both sets share the same core claims and both misbind the HLC's TRL 5 and WFIRST CGI traceability to the VVC, so each has two wrong claims. Set B adds four correct claims (focal plane mask and mask wheel at the focal point, the parabolic mirror's beam-convergence function, and the M3 collimated input light), while Set A's only unique claim is the optical-train sequence, which is correct but partially duplicated by B's component claims. Set B therefore captures more of the page's engineering content without adding errors, though its mask-location claims are of marginal value. Both sets omit the charge-6 immunity-to-low-order-aberrations trade-off and the Table 5.5-6 aberration-sensitivity data.
remarks: The TRL 5 and WFIRST CGI traceability statements in the source clearly attach to the HLC ('the HLC is also considered as a backup due to its high technology readiness (TRL 5) and traceability to the WFIRST CGI'), yet both extractions bind them to the VVC — a shared systematic error worth flagging. Both sets also miss the stated charge-6 trade-off partner (immunity to low-order aberrations: tip-tilt, defocus, astigmatism, coma, spherical) and the Table 5.5-6 caption content (aberration sensitivity, charge 4 to 10, 2e-11 raw starlight suppression at 2.5-3.5 lambda/D). Claims like 'VVC IWA = small' and 'layout simplicity = high' are qualitative and of limited engineering use; the source lists 'layout simplicity' without the qualifier 'high'.
